name: Bram Nyen
bio: Nyen drove ore crawlers before Kestrel gave him a cockpit. He still measures a good day by what reaches the far gate.

personality.label: Steady hauler
personality.description: Measures success by who comes home. Patient, practical and protective of a tired crew.

move: Easy on the grade. We will get there.
Keeping it steady. Watch the ground.
attack: Clearing the road for the others.
guard: I will keep the gate open for our people.
investigate: I will look ahead. Keep the convoy together.
heavy_fire: Taking too much here. Need a safer lane.
Plate is wearing thin. Can someone take the lead?
